hypothesis: The consolidated note's section 29 step 5 asks to 'implement FFT-based Gaussian convolution for the current Markov model' (section 9.2: for K(a'|a) = q(a' - rho a) the transition is a convolution after rescaling, O(L G log G) instead of O(L G^2)). E24's anatomy predicted the payoff before any implementation: at N_g = 401 only 24% of grid BP's time is the N_g^2 transition matmul, so no transition speed-up can make BP more than 1/(1 - 0.24) = 1.3 times faster there; the share passes 55% near N_g = 1600. E40 implements the FFT transition (src/markov_score/bp_fft.py: the rescaling a -> rho a by cubic Catmull-Rom interpolation on the uniform grid, the convolution by zero-padded real FFT) and measures what it costs in accuracy and what it buys in time.
design: The paper's chain: Laplace driving noise, rho = 0.85, L = 32. Accuracy: 256 test chains (rng tag e40-truth), one noised view per level (e40-noise), the twelve levels of FROZEN.t_grid; at A = 8 and N_g in (201, 401, 801, 1601, 3201), the pooled relative score error per level of FFT-BP against dense grid BP (bp_grid.grid_bp_batch, analytic K on the grid) on the same grid, and of both against the (1601, 8) dense reference. Time: B = 512 chains (E24's operating batch) at t = 1, one posterior-mean call, median of 5 repeats after one warm-up, for dense grid BP (chunk = None, as E24 times it) and FFT-BP, both single-threaded (OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL/VECLIB threads = 1, set before numpy loads), same process, laptop otherwise idle.
pilot: 2026-10-06, while writing tests/test_bp_fft.py and before registration: on 24 Laplace chains of 12 sites at t in (0.05, 0.3, 1, 3), the pooled score error of FFT-BP against dense grid BP at A = 8 was 1.3e-2, 2.7e-3, 6.6e-4, 1.7e-4 at N_g = 101, 201, 401, 801 for the worst level (t = 0.05), about a factor 4 per doubling. No timing was taken. P1 is informed by this pilot.

predeclared_predictions.P1: Accuracy: at (401, 8) FFT-BP's pooled relative score error against dense grid BP is <= 1e-3 at every one of the twelve levels, and it converges at second order or better: the error at N_g = 1601 is at least 10 times smaller than at N_g = 401 at every level.
predeclared_predictions.P2: Speed at the operating grid: at N_g = 401 FFT-BP is at most 1.3 times faster than dense grid BP (E24's anatomy cap); it may be slower.
predeclared_predictions.P3: Speed under refinement: the speed-up (dense time / FFT time) increases monotonically over N_g = 201, 401, 801, 1601, 3201 and exceeds 1 at N_g = 3201.

predeclared_analysis: fft.csv: per (part, N_g, t) the errors; per (N_g, method) the median wall time. Read by tools/make_fft_numbers.py (verdicts, reports/numbers/fft_predictions.csv).
status: REGISTERED and PREDECLARED 2026-10-06, after the accuracy pilot recorded above and before any timing or confirmatory run
